name: Self-serve booking page to closing claim
looks: A small public booking page, held at a fixed gentle tilt, shows a date picker and a list of services with prices; a cursor taps a day, a time slot highlights and a service locks in. It cuts to a confirmation card ticking a booking number up, then to a plain closing line that stacks in two parts, the second in the accent colour, before the wordmark and URL settle to close.
build: ui-tilt-card for the booking page's fixed perspective and drift; the date and slot selection are quick highlight-state swaps, power2.out. The confirmation number uses live-readout-hud's no-ease counting. The close reuses list-stack-reveal for the two-line claim, then wordmark-assemble for the logo lockup.
sound: A soft whoosh as the tilted page settles, a tick on the slot selection, a confirm chime on the booking number, then a tick per closing line and a final soft hit on the logo.
prompt: Close the loop with self-service: a small tilted booking page lets a cursor pick a day and a time with no agent involved, resolving into a confirmed booking number, then land the film's closing claim as a two-line stack with the payoff word in the brand's accent colour, finishing on the logo.
